import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
import time

start_time = time.time()

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
]


# Function to extract time features from datetime
def add_time_features(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    df_copy["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df_copy["pickup_datetime"])

    df_copy["hour"] = df_copy["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df_copy["day_of_week"] = df_copy["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df_copy["month"] = df_copy["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df_copy["is_weekend"] = df_copy["day_of_week"].apply(lambda x: 1 if x >= 5 else 0)
    df_copy["is_night"] = df_copy["hour"].apply(lambda x: 1 if x < 6 or x > 20 else 0)

    return df_copy


# Add time features to train and test
train_data = add_time_features(train_df)
test_data = add_time_features(test_df)

# Fill missing coordinate values with median (they look corrupted)
median_dropoff_lat = train_data["dropoff_latitude"].median()
median_dropoff_lon = train_data["dropoff_longitude"].median()
train_data.fillna(
    {"dropoff_latitude": median_dropoff_lat, "dropoff_longitude": median_dropoff_lon},
    inplace=True,
)
test_data.fillna(
    {"dropoff_latitude": median_dropoff_lat, "dropoff_longitude": median_dropoff_lon},
    inplace=True,
)

# Split training data into train and validation (hold out for evaluation)
split_idx = int(len(train_data) * 0.8)
train_final = train_data.iloc[:split_idx].copy()
val_data = train_data.iloc[split_idx:].copy()

# Prepare features and target
X_train = train_final[
    feature_cols
    + list(train_final.columns)
    .index("hour") : list(train_final.columns)
    .index("is_night")
    + 1
]
y_train = train_final["fare_amount"]

X_val = val_data[
    feature_cols
    + list(val_data.columns).index("hour") : list(val_data.columns).index("is_night")
    + 1
]
y_val = val_data["fare_amount"]

X_test = test_data[
    feature_cols
    + list(test_data.columns).index("hour") : list(test_data.columns).index("is_night")
    + 1
]

# Reorder to get consistent feature set
final_feature_names = [c for c in feature_cols]
for col in ["hour", "day_of_week", "month", "is_weekend", "is_night"]:
    final_feature_names.append(col)

X_train = X_train[final_feature_names]
X_val = X_val[final_feature_names]
X_test = X_test[final_feature_names]

print(f"\nFinal feature names: {len(final_feature_names)}")
print(f"Train features: {X_train.shape[1]}")

# Train LightGBM model
try:
    import lightgbm as lgb

    print("Using LightGBM...")
    model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=10,
        num_leaves=31,
        min_child_samples=20,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
    )

    model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)])

except ImportError:
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor

    print("Using Random Forest (LightGBM not available)...")
    model = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=200, max_depth=15, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set (this is genuine hold-out estimate)
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_predictions))
print(f"\nValidation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission DataFrame with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_data["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions})

submission = submission.sort_values("key").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to submission.csv
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv ({len(submission)} rows)")

# Print timing
elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"Total runtime: {elapsed_time:.2f} seconds")
